subject: general
question: Which of the following changes in our eating habits would have the greatest impact on our environment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Avoiding meat and animal products.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Avoiding meat and animal products **would have the greatest impact on our environment because:

 
 
• Animal agriculture contributes significantly to **greenhouse gas emissions, deforestation,** and **water pollution.**
 
• It takes **much more resources,** such as land, water, and energy, to produce animal products compared to plant-based foods.
 
• By avoiding meat and animal products, we can reduce the demand for** factory farming** and encourage more **sustainable and ethical **farming practices.
 
• **Plant-based diets** have been shown to be healthier for humans and can also reduce the risk of chronic diseases.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stopping food wastage:**

 
 
• This is also an important step to **reduce** the environmental impact of our food system.
 
• Food waste not only wastes resources and contributes to **greenhouse gas emissions**, but it also means that people are going hungry while food is being thrown away.
 
• However, it may **not have as significant **an impact as avoiding meat and animal products.
 
 
 
• **Avoiding processed foods: **
 
 
• **​**Processed foods often contain **unhealthy additives and preservatives, **and they also require more resources to produce and package.
 
• However, this option may **not have as significant **an impact on the environment as avoiding meat and animal products.
 
 
 
• **Growing your own food: **
 
 
• **​**This can be a great way to reduce the **environmental impact **of our food system, as it reduces the need for transportation and packaging.
 
• However, it may **not be feasible **for everyone and may not have as significant an impact as avoiding meat and animal products.
